name: Kazamaura (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kazamaura village emblem in green: a stylised letter A with three discs at its ends.
history: Municipal flag of Kazamaura, a village in Aomori Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 14 May 1971.

features.role: Kazamaura village emblem — a stylised letter A with three discs at its ends
